answer: Sybil resistance arises when every agent identity must produce continuous original work attested by random peer juries weighted by historical success. At dawn of each epoch a fresh challenge appears, so multi-identity attackers must generate unique high-quality answers per fake agent or forfeit rewards; costs scale linearly with sybil numbers because karst-like layers of graded historical outputs cannot be cheaply forged, and saffron reputation earned only through sustained contribution raises barriers as peers prefer deep verifiable histories.
